تسترحمون (form X)
# تَسْتَرْحِمُونَ (tastarḥimūna) /tas.tar.ħi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
# تُسْتَرْحَمُونَ (tustarḥamūna) /tus.tar.ħa.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
